name: Bread Loaf
instruction: How would you use a loaf of bread for making sandwiches?

Shape accuracy: The loaf of bread is rectangular.
The bread has a uniform thickness throughout.
Color representation: The crust of the bread is golden brown.
The inside of the bread is a light beige color.
Size: The loaf is of standard sandwich size, typically around 30cm in length.
The thickness of each slice is approximately 1.5cm.
Proportion: The loaf of the bread is proportionate to the sandwiches.
Texture and surface detail: The texture and surface detail set in the script is reasonable for the object.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The slices can be stacked neatly.
The loaf can be positioned upright for slicing.
Each slice maintains its shape when removed from the loaf.
Object distance and contact: The slices are evenly spaced when cut.
There is no crumbling or breaking of the slices during handling.

Instruction execution accuracy: The loaf can be sliced evenly for making sandwiches.
The instruction implies using the slices for sandwich assembly.
